title: Basis of the Return Credit on Crop Protection Product, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Crop protection product that has come back to the plant is credited to the member's crop input account against the delivery it was billed on, which is the most recent crop protection line invoiced on the account.

1. **Quantity.** The quantity credited is the whole of the quantity that line billed.
2. **Unit price.** The unit price the credit is computed at is the unit price the line coming back was invoiced at.
3. **Credited value.** The credited value is the quantity credited multiplied by the unit price the credit is computed at, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.
4. **Restocking rate.** The restocking rate is the restocking charge the programme carries.
5. **Waived share.** The waived share of the restocking charge is nil.
6. **Restocking charge withheld.** The restocking charge withheld from the credit is the credited value multiplied by the restocking rate and then reduced by the waived share of itself, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places once at the end of that step.
7. **Handling.** Bringing product back across the scale and re-shelving it is charged at the rates the programme carries for the equivalent delivery work, because the same crew and the same scale time are used. The handling figure withheld from the credit, which covers bringing the product back across the scale and re-shelving it, is the programme's split load charge.
8. **The credit written.** The credit written against the invoice is the credited value less the restocking charge withheld and less the handling figure withheld, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places once at the end; the restocking charge and the handling figure are each taken off the credited value itself and neither is taken off the other.

## The same basis worked through on hypothetical figures

A member on a programme of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts whose restocking charge is 12 percent and whose split load charge is 45.00 USD brings crop protection product back. The most recent crop protection line invoiced on the account billed 10 cases at 412.50 USD the case.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Quantity credited | 10 cases |
| Unit price the credit is computed at | 412.50 USD |
| Credited value | 4125.00 USD |
| Restocking rate | 12 percent |
| Waived share of the restocking charge | nil |
| Restocking charge withheld | 495.00 USD |
| Handling figure withheld | 45.00 USD |
| Credit written against the invoice | 3585.00 USD |

Both the restocking charge and the handling figure come off the credited value of 4125.00 USD; the handling figure is not taken off the 3630.00 USD that stands after the restocking charge.
